project(iernonce)

include_directories(include)

spec2def(iernonce.dll iernonce.spec)

# iernonce.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/iernonce-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(iernonce_shims OBJECT dialog.cpp iernonce.cpp registry.cpp)
target_link_libraries(iernonce_shims PRIVATE cppstl atl_classes libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libgdi32 libole32 libshell32 libshlwapi libkernel32 libuser32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(iernonce_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
set_target_cpp_properties(iernonce_shims WITH_EXCEPTIONS)
add_cargo_module(iernonce iernonce-cargo iernonce.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS iernonce_shims psdk xdk)
